supplementary_browser_and_web_build.command: env CI=1 PW_TEST_REPORTER=list T212PI_E2E_TIMINGS=1 make test-e2e build-web

known_p208_limitations: Source-backed known P2-08 limitations remain: the normal complete seed has three accounts, but Compose does not forward the documented T212PI_ACCOUNT_ID setting to web; unconfigured multi-account overview startup is not accepted. The accepted runtime used an explicit baseline-account scratch override. The global header must respect the authorized route account. Sticky-header section positioning, readable mobile labels and table presentation remain P2-08/S39 follow-up work. Configured runtime acceptance does not prove default unconfigured multi-account UI behavior.
scope: Scoped P2-04 synthetic acceptance; full Phase 2 and shared S34 remain incomplete.
